scope: One method-locked CIFAR-100 official-test evaluation of six P4 best checkpoints and threshold 0.903; no test-time tuning.
historical_test_disclosure: Legacy baseline-only CIFAR-100 runs exposed test metrics before P4. P3 stopped without test. No P4 checkpoint or policy has seen official test data; describe a later pass as method-locked rather than globally blind.
limitations: CIFAR-100 test was historically exposed by unrelated legacy baseline runs.
Worst-class evidence has only 100 test examples per class.
The 4pp class-risk boundary was developed after the frozen P3 failure.
MAC saving is an operation-count proxy rather than new hardware latency.
recommended_next_step: Stop new training and proceed to frozen paper tables, figures and writing.
